chains.name: Bitcoin
chains.description: Bitcoin is the original and most secure cryptocurrency network. Connect to Bitcoin RPC and Blockbook endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Bitcoin is the first and largest decentralized blockchain — a UTXO-based, SHA-256 proof-of-work network that settles more value than any other chain. SwiftNodes serves the standard Bitcoin Core JSON-RPC interface plus a Blockbook address/index API, so you can query balances, UTXOs, and transaction history without running your own archival node.

chains.name: Litecoin
chains.description: Litecoin is a fast, low-fee UTXO cryptocurrency. Connect to Litecoin RPC and Blockbook endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Litecoin is one of the oldest and most established cryptocurrencies — a UTXO-based, Scrypt proof-of-work chain designed for fast, low-cost payments. SwiftNodes serves the standard Litecoin Core JSON-RPC interface plus a Blockbook address/index API, so you can query balances, UTXOs, and transaction history without running your own node.

chains.name: Dogecoin
chains.description: Dogecoin is a fast, low-fee UTXO cryptocurrency used for payments and tipping. Connect to Dogecoin RPC and Blockbook endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Dogecoin is one of the most widely-held cryptocurrencies — a UTXO-based, Scrypt proof-of-work chain designed for fast, cheap payments and tipping. SwiftNodes serves the standard Dogecoin Core JSON-RPC interface plus a Blockbook address/index API, so you can query balances, UTXOs, and transaction history without running your own node.

chains.name: Ethereum
chains.description: Ethereum is the leading smart contract platform. Connect to Ethereum mainnet with SwiftNodes for fast, reliable RPC access.
chains.overview: Ethereum is the original general-purpose smart contract blockchain and the foundation of decentralized finance, NFTs, and on-chain governance. SwiftNodes provides reliable, low-latency Ethereum mainnet RPC with both HTTP and WebSocket support across load-balanced upstream nodes.

chains.name: BNB Smart Chain
chains.description: BNB Smart Chain (BSC) offers low-cost, high-speed transactions. Access BSC RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: BNB Smart Chain is a high-throughput EVM-compatible Layer 1 launched and operated by Binance. With sub-second block times and gas fees typically under a cent, BSC is a popular destination for retail DeFi, GameFi, and memecoin activity.

chains.name: Base
chains.description: Base is Coinbase's Layer 2 network built on Optimism. Get reliable Base RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Base is Coinbase's Ethereum Layer 2, built on the OP Stack and secured by Ethereum. Launched in August 2023, Base has become one of the fastest-growing L2s, driven by Coinbase's wallet integration and a friendly developer experience.

chains.name: Arbitrum
chains.description: Arbitrum One is a leading Ethereum Layer 2 rollup. Connect to Arbitrum with low-latency RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Arbitrum One is the largest Ethereum optimistic rollup by TVL and transaction count. It runs the Arbitrum Nitro stack, achieves near-instant transaction throughput, and remains highly compatible with EVM contract semantics.

chains.name: Robinhood Chain
chains.description: Robinhood Chain is an Arbitrum Orbit Layer 2 for tokenized real-world assets. Connect to Robinhood Chain RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Robinhood Chain is an EVM Layer 2 built on Arbitrum Orbit (the Arbitrum Nitro stack), purpose-built for tokenized real-world assets — led by Robinhood's tokenized Stock Tokens. It uses ETH for gas and has no separate native token, so existing Ethereum tooling works unchanged.

chains.name: Optimism
chains.description: Optimism is an Ethereum Layer 2 using optimistic rollups. Get fast Optimism RPC access with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Optimism (OP Mainnet) is an Ethereum L2 optimistic rollup and the foundational chain of the Superchain — a network of OP Stack rollups including Base, Mode, Zora, World Chain, and more. OP Mainnet pioneered the modular rollup-as-a-service model.

chains.name: Polygon
chains.description: Polygon is a popular Ethereum sidechain for scalable dApps. Access Polygon RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Polygon PoS is a high-throughput EVM-compatible chain that scales Ethereum with sub-cent transaction fees and 2-second block times. With years of production use, deep stablecoin liquidity, and major brand adoption, Polygon remains one of the most widely-deployed scaling solutions.

chains.name: Avalanche
chains.description: Avalanche C-Chain provides high-throughput EVM-compatible transactions. Connect to Avalanche RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Avalanche is a heterogeneous network of blockchains. The C-Chain is Avalanche's EVM-compatible smart contract chain, offering near-instant finality (~1-2 seconds) and high throughput via the novel Snowman/Avalanche consensus.

chains.name: Sonic
chains.description: Sonic (formerly Fantom) is a high-performance EVM chain. Access Sonic RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Sonic is the rebranded and upgraded version of Fantom, launched in late 2024 with a new high-performance EVM execution layer (Sonic Engine). It offers sub-second finality and 10,000+ TPS targets, with an aggressive fee-sharing model that returns 90% of gas fees to dApp developers.

chains.name: Scroll
chains.description: Scroll is a zkEVM Layer 2 for Ethereum scalability. Access Scroll RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Scroll is a bytecode-equivalent zkEVM rollup on Ethereum. It compiles Solidity contracts with identical opcode behavior to mainnet, generating zk-SNARK proofs for state transitions to inherit Ethereum's security with sub-Ethereum gas costs.

chains.name: Linea
chains.description: Linea is ConsenSys' zkEVM Layer 2 network. Get reliable Linea RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Linea is ConsenSys' zkEVM Layer 2, designed to bring Ethereum applications to scale with full EVM equivalence. Backed by the team behind MetaMask, Infura, and Truffle, Linea integrates deeply with the most-used Ethereum developer tooling.

chains.name: zkSync Era
chains.description: zkSync Era is a Layer 2 ZK rollup for Ethereum with native account abstraction. Connect to zkSync Era RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes for fast, low-cost transactions.
chains.overview: zkSync Era is a general-purpose zk-rollup developed by Matter Labs. It pioneered native account abstraction at the protocol level, allowing every account to be a smart contract with custom signing, gas payment, and multi-sig logic.

chains.name: Blast
chains.description: Blast is an Ethereum Layer 2 with native yield. Connect to Blast RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Blast is an Ethereum L2 with a defining feature: native yield on bridged ETH and stablecoins. Bridged ETH automatically earns staking yield, and USDB (the stablecoin) earns T-bill yield, both rebasing into user accounts without requiring any action.

chains.name: Mantle
chains.description: Mantle is an Ethereum Layer 2 with modular architecture. Connect to Mantle RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Mantle is a modular Ethereum Layer 2 that separates execution, settlement, and data availability. It uses EigenDA for data availability — the first major L2 to do so — significantly reducing data costs compared to chains that post calldata to Ethereum.

chains.name: Gnosis
chains.description: Gnosis Chain (formerly xDai) is a stable payments blockchain. Access Gnosis RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Gnosis Chain is an EVM-compatible chain with stable, predictable transaction costs paid in xDai (USD-pegged stablecoin). It's secured by a large validator set (similar to Ethereum) and is widely used for community payments, DAO operations, and Safe (Gnosis Safe) multi-sig deployments.

chains.name: Taiko
chains.description: Taiko is a decentralized Ethereum-equivalent zkRollup. Access Taiko RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Taiko is a Type-1 zk-rollup — the most Ethereum-equivalent of the zkEVMs. Every Ethereum block can theoretically be re-executed on Taiko's prover, and contracts deploy bit-identically. Taiko emphasizes decentralization: anyone can propose blocks (based rollup) and anyone can prove them.

chains.name: Flare
chains.description: Flare is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain designed for decentralized data acquisition. Connect to Flare RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Flare is a Layer 1 EVM blockchain focused on providing decentralized data to smart contracts through native oracle protocols. It pairs EVM execution with built-in data acquisition layers (FTSO price feeds and the FDC state connector), so contracts can consume external price and chain data without third-party oracle deployments.

chains.name: Cronos
chains.description: Cronos is Crypto.com's EVM-compatible blockchain. Access Cronos RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Cronos is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 built with the Cosmos SDK and a Tendermint-based consensus, backed by Crypto.com. It offers fast deterministic finality, low fees, and IBC interoperability with the broader Cosmos ecosystem.

chains.name: Rootstock
chains.description: Rootstock (RSK) brings smart contract functionality to Bitcoin. Connect to Rootstock RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Rootstock (RSK) is an EVM-compatible smart contract sidechain secured by the Bitcoin network through merged mining. Its native gas token, RBTC, is pegged 1:1 to BTC, bringing programmable smart contracts to Bitcoin holders.

chains.name: Telos EVM
chains.description: Telos EVM is a high-speed, low-cost EVM-compatible blockchain with zero front-running. Connect to Telos RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Telos EVM is a high-throughput EVM layer running on the Telos Layer 1, which uses Antelope (formerly EOSIO) delegated proof-of-stake consensus. It offers sub-second blocks, fixed low fees, and front-running resistance through fair transaction ordering.

chains.name: Ethereum Classic
chains.description: Ethereum Classic is the original Ethereum chain preserving immutability. Access ETC RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Ethereum Classic is the continuation of the original Ethereum chain that did not adopt the 2016 DAO hard fork. It remains a proof-of-work, EVM-compatible Layer 1 that upholds transaction immutability under the principle that code is law.

chains.name: Shibarium
chains.description: Shibarium is the Layer 2 blockchain for the Shiba Inu ecosystem. Connect to Shibarium RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Shibarium is an Ethereum Layer 2 network developed for the Shiba Inu ecosystem. It uses a Polygon-style architecture with a Heimdall validation layer and a Bor block-production layer, offering low fees and EVM compatibility.

chains.name: Fuse
chains.description: Fuse is an EVM-compatible blockchain designed for everyday payments and DeFi. Connect to Fuse RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Fuse is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain focused on payments and consumer applications. It uses a delegated proof-of-stake validator set with the AuRa consensus mechanism, offering low fees and fast blocks.

chains.name: Unichain
chains.description: Unichain is Uniswap's dedicated DeFi chain. Access Unichain RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Unichain is an Ethereum Layer 2 rollup built by Uniswap Labs on the OP Stack and part of the Optimism Superchain. It is purpose-built for DeFi, with fast block times and ETH as its native gas token.

chains.name: Monad
chains.description: Monad is a high-performance EVM Layer 1 with 10,000 TPS. Connect to Monad RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Monad is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain that is fully EVM-compatible while introducing parallel execution and a pipelined BFT consensus. SwiftNodes provides low-latency Monad RPC over HTTP and WebSocket across load-balanced upstream nodes.

chains.name: Manta Pacific
chains.category: Layer 2 (OP Stack optimistic rollup, Celestia DA / validium)
chains.description: Manta Pacific is a modular Layer 2 using Celestia for data availability and Polygon zkEVM technology. Connect to Manta Pacific RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Manta Pacific is an EVM-compatible Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack that uses Celestia for modular data availability, operating as a validium. It uses ETH as its gas token and targets low-cost smart contract execution, with an emphasis on zero-knowledge applications.

chains.name: opBNB
chains.category: Layer 2 (OP Stack optimistic rollup on BNB Smart Chain)
chains.description: opBNB is BNB Chain's Layer 2 scaling solution. Connect to opBNB RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: opBNB is a Layer 2 scaling network for BNB Smart Chain built on the Optimism OP Stack (Bedrock). It uses BNB as its gas token and is tuned for high throughput and low fees.

chains.name: Fraxtal
chains.description: Fraxtal is Frax Finance's Layer 2 modular rollup. Connect to Fraxtal RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Fraxtal is a Layer 2 network from Frax Finance built on the OP Stack, designed as the settlement layer for the Frax ecosystem. It uses a native gas token in the FRAX family rather than ETH.

chains.name: Boba Network
chains.blockTime: Variable; blocks are produced as transactions arrive
chains.description: Boba Network is an Ethereum Layer 2 with hybrid compute capabilities. Connect to Boba Network RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Boba Network is an EVM-compatible Ethereum Layer 2 optimistic rollup known for Hybrid Compute, a feature that lets smart contracts call external compute and APIs during execution. The Ethereum deployment uses ETH for gas, with BOBA serving as the network's governance and utility token.

chains.name: PulseChain
chains.description: PulseChain is an Ethereum fork with lower fees. Connect to PulseChain RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: PulseChain is a Layer 1 EVM blockchain created as a full-state hard fork of Ethereum, copying Ethereum's accounts, tokens, and contracts at a snapshot. Its native gas token is PLS, and token contracts on the network follow the PRC-20 standard equivalent to ERC-20.

chains.name: Astar
chains.description: Astar Network is a multi-chain smart contract platform supporting EVM and WASM on Polkadot. Connect to Astar RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Astar is a smart contract network in the Polkadot ecosystem that exposes an EVM environment alongside WebAssembly (Wasm) contracts. Chain 592 is Astar's EVM endpoint, where ASTR is the native gas token.

chains.name: Metis
chains.description: Metis is an Ethereum Layer 2 for decentralized businesses. Connect to Metis RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Metis (Andromeda) is an EVM-equivalent Ethereum Layer 2 optimistic rollup that uses METIS as its native gas token. It is notable for being among the first optimistic rollups to decentralize its sequencer.

chains.name: Polygon zkEVM
chains.description: Polygon zkEVM is a ZK rollup providing Ethereum-equivalent scalability with zero-knowledge proofs. Connect to Polygon zkEVM RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Polygon zkEVM is a zero-knowledge rollup that settles to Ethereum, using zk-SNARK validity proofs to inherit Ethereum security while cutting gas costs. It targets EVM-equivalence, so existing Solidity contracts and tooling work with little or no modification.

chains.name: WEMIX
chains.description: WEMIX is a gaming-focused blockchain platform by Wemade. Connect to WEMIX RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: WEMIX3.0 is a Layer 1 EVM blockchain from Korean game company Wemade, focused on blockchain gaming, DeFi, and payments. Its native token WEMIX is used for gas and staking.

chains.name: Core
chains.description: Core is a Bitcoin-aligned Layer 1 blockchain combining Bitcoin mining with DeFi. Connect to Core RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Core is a Bitcoin-aligned EVM Layer 1 secured by Satoshi Plus, a consensus model combining delegated Bitcoin hash power with delegated proof-of-stake. It positions itself as a settlement and DeFi layer for Bitcoin holders while remaining fully Ethereum-compatible for Solidity contracts.

chains.name: Sei
chains.description: Sei is a high-performance Layer 1 optimized for trading. Connect to Sei EVM RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Sei is a high-throughput Layer 1 whose EVM execution layer (chain ID 1329) offers a parallelized EVM built for trading and DeFi. It combines Cosmos-based consensus with full EVM bytecode compatibility, letting Ethereum contracts deploy without code changes.

chains.name: Story
chains.description: Story — now the DATA Network — is a blockchain for intellectual property and AI training data. Connect to Story / DATA Network RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Story, rebranded to the DATA Network in June 2026, is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 originally purpose-built for registering intellectual property on-chain and now focused on infrastructure for sourcing, verifying, and licensing AI training data. It combines a Cosmos SDK / CometBFT consensus layer with an EVM execution layer, and the chain itself (chain ID 1514) is unchanged by the rebrand.

chains.name: Soneium
chains.category: Ethereum Layer 2 (OP Stack optimistic rollup, Superchain)
chains.description: Soneium is Sony's Ethereum Layer 2 network. Access Soneium RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Soneium is an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack and part of the Optimism Superchain, developed by Sony Block Solutions Labs, a joint venture between Sony Group and Startale. It uses ETH for gas and inherits security from Ethereum through optimistic rollup settlement.

chains.name: Kava
chains.description: Kava combines Cosmos and Ethereum in one chain. Connect to Kava EVM RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Kava is a Cosmos-based Layer 1 with a co-chain architecture that pairs a Cosmos SDK chain with a fully compatible Ethereum (EVM) co-chain. It runs on Tendermint consensus and uses KAVA as the gas and staking token across both environments.

chains.name: Beam
chains.description: Beam is a gaming-focused blockchain built as an Avalanche subnet. Connect to Beam RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Beam is an EVM-compatible gaming blockchain by the Merit Circle DAO, deployed as an Avalanche Subnet (now L1). It targets games and NFTs with sub-second to few-second finality and BEAM as the native gas token.

chains.name: IoTeX
chains.description: IoTeX is an EVM-compatible blockchain powering the decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN) ecosystem. Connect to IoTeX RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: IoTeX is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 focused on DePIN (decentralized physical infrastructure networks) and connecting real-world devices to blockchains. It uses Roll-DPoS consensus for fast, instant-finality block production.

chains.name: ZetaChain
chains.description: ZetaChain is an L1 blockchain enabling omnichain smart contracts across any chain. Connect to ZetaChain RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: ZetaChain is a Cosmos-SDK Layer 1 with an EVM (ZetaEVM) designed for omnichain smart contracts that can read from and write to connected chains, including non-smart-contract chains like Bitcoin, without wrapped assets. SwiftNodes provides ZetaChain mainnet RPC over HTTP and WebSocket.

chains.name: Canto
chains.description: Canto is a DeFi-native Layer 1 blockchain with free public infrastructure. Connect to Canto RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Canto is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 built with the Cosmos SDK and CometBFT (Tendermint), focused on providing DeFi primitives such as a DEX, lending market, and the NOTE unit of account as free public infrastructure. SwiftNodes provides Canto mainnet RPC over HTTP and WebSocket.

chains.name: Kaia
chains.description: Kaia (formerly Klaytn) is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain popular in Asia. Connect to Kaia RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes for fast, reliable access.
chains.overview: Kaia is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 formed in August 2024 by merging the Klaytn and Finschia blockchains, targeting consumer and enterprise applications across Asia. SwiftNodes provides Kaia mainnet RPC over HTTP and WebSocket.

chains.name: Plasma
chains.description: Plasma is a next-generation blockchain scaling solution. Access Plasma RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Plasma is a stablecoin-focused EVM Layer 1 built for high-volume stablecoin payments, with a paymaster model that allows zero-fee USDT transfers and gas payable in stablecoins. SwiftNodes provides Plasma mainnet RPC over HTTP and WebSocket.

chains.name: Immutable zkEVM
chains.description: Immutable zkEVM is the leading blockchain for gaming, powered by Polygon's zkEVM technology. Connect to Immutable zkEVM RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Immutable zkEVM is a gaming-focused Ethereum Layer 2 built with the Polygon CDK, using IMX for gas to provide low fees for Web3 games. SwiftNodes provides Immutable zkEVM mainnet RPC over HTTP and WebSocket.

chains.name: Mode
chains.description: Mode is an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack, designed for DeFi growth. Connect to Mode RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Mode is an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack and part of the Optimism Superchain, focused on DeFi and on-chain financial applications. SwiftNodes provides Mode mainnet RPC over HTTP and WebSocket.

chains.name: Celo
chains.description: Celo is a mobile-first blockchain for financial inclusion. Access Celo RPC endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Celo is a mobile-first network that migrated from a standalone Layer 1 to an Ethereum Layer 2 in March 2025, built on the OP Stack with EigenDA for data availability. SwiftNodes provides Celo mainnet RPC over HTTP and WebSocket.

chains.name: Berachain
chains.description: Berachain is a DeFi-focused EVM chain using proof-of-liquidity. Connect to Berachain RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Berachain is an EVM-identical Layer 1 built on a Proof-of-Liquidity consensus model. Instead of rewarding raw staking, Proof-of-Liquidity ties validator rewards to liquidity provided to the ecosystem, aiming to align chain security with on-chain economic activity.

chains.name: Chiliz
chains.description: Chiliz Chain powers sports and entertainment fan tokens. Connect to Chiliz RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Chiliz Chain is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 for sports and entertainment, powering Socios.com fan tokens and related applications with CHZ as the gas token. SwiftNodes provides Chiliz Chain mainnet RPC over HTTP and WebSocket.

chains.name: Katana
chains.blockTime: Fast block times typical of OP-style L2s.
chains.description: Katana is a high-performance blockchain network. Connect to Katana RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Katana is a DeFi-focused Ethereum Layer 2 that concentrates liquidity and routes protocol revenue back into yield for its users. It launched its public mainnet in 2025 with backing from Polygon Labs and GSR. SwiftNodes provides RPC access to Katana.

chains.name: Zora
chains.category: Layer 2 (OP Stack optimistic rollup, Optimism Superchain)
chains.description: Zora is an Ethereum Layer 2 built for creators and NFTs. Connect to Zora RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Zora Network is an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack and part of the Optimism Superchain, oriented toward creators, NFTs, and onchain media. It uses ETH for gas and inherits Ethereum security through optimistic rollup settlement.

chains.name: Aurora
chains.description: Aurora is an EVM-compatible blockchain built on the NEAR Protocol. Connect to Aurora RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Aurora is an EVM environment running on the NEAR Protocol, letting Ethereum applications deploy unchanged while settling on NEAR. It uses ETH as its gas token and offers sub-second block times.

chains.name: Harmony
chains.description: Harmony is a fast and open blockchain for decentralized applications. Connect to Harmony RPC endpoints with SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Harmony is a sharded proof-of-stake Layer 1 with EVM compatibility, using its native ONE token for gas and staking. It launched mainnet in 2019 and targets fast, low-fee transactions.

chains.name: Solana
chains.description: Solana is a high-speed blockchain supporting 65,000 TPS. Access Solana RPC and WebSocket endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Solana is a high-throughput Layer 1 blockchain optimized for speed and low cost. With ~400ms block times, sub-cent transaction fees, and theoretical throughput up to 65,000 TPS, Solana hosts a thriving DeFi, NFT, and memecoin ecosystem alongside enterprise pilots.

chains.name: TRON
chains.description: TRON is a blockchain for decentralized content and entertainment. Connect to TRON HTTP and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: TRON is a high-throughput blockchain with a strong focus on stablecoin transfers — particularly USDT, which has the largest supply on TRON of any chain. With sub-cent fees and 3-second block times, TRON is a major rail for retail and emerging-market stablecoin flows.

chains.name: Sui
chains.description: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain from Mysten Labs using the Move language. Connect to Sui RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Sui is a high-performance Layer 1 from Mysten Labs built around an object-centric data model and the Move programming language. Independent transactions execute in parallel rather than through a single global queue, giving Sui high throughput and sub-second finality for simple transfers.

chains.name: Starknet
chains.blockTime: Variable block production; not a fixed EVM-style interval
chains.description: Starknet is a validity rollup using STARK proofs for Ethereum scaling. Access Starknet RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Starknet is a validity (ZK) rollup on Ethereum that uses STARK proofs to verify state transitions. Contracts are written in Cairo rather than Solidity, and it is non-EVM at the execution layer.

chains.name: Polkadot
chains.description: Polkadot connects multiple specialized blockchains into one network. Access Polkadot RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Polkadot is a Substrate-based relay chain that coordinates shared security and interoperability for connected rollups and parachains. It is non-EVM at the relay-chain level and uses the DOT token for staking, governance, and coordination.

chains.name: Kusama
chains.description: Kusama is Polkadot's canary network for experimental features. Connect to Kusama RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Kusama is Polkadot's canary network — a fully functional, value-bearing chain that shares Polkadot's codebase but moves faster and with lower economic stakes. Teams use it to test parachains, runtime upgrades, and governance before deploying to Polkadot.

chains.name: Cosmos Hub
chains.description: Cosmos Hub is the central chain of the Cosmos ecosystem. Access Cosmos RPC, REST, and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Cosmos Hub is the flagship chain of the Cosmos ecosystem and the original home of the Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol (IBC). Secured by the ATOM token under CometBFT (Tendermint) consensus, it offers ~6-second blocks with instant, single-slot finality.

chains.name: Osmosis
chains.description: Osmosis is the leading DEX in the Cosmos ecosystem. Connect to Osmosis RPC, REST, and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Osmosis is a Cosmos SDK application chain built as an automated market maker and DeFi hub for the IBC ecosystem. It is non-EVM, using CometBFT (Tendermint) consensus and the OSMO token for governance and fees.

chains.name: Injective
chains.description: Injective is a DeFi-focused Layer 1 for decentralized finance. Access Injective RPC and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Injective is a Cosmos SDK Layer 1 built for finance, featuring native exchange and orderbook modules. It uses CometBFT (Tendermint) consensus for fast finality and the INJ token for gas, staking, and governance.

chains.name: Celestia
chains.category: Modular data availability layer (Cosmos SDK / CometBFT)
chains.description: Celestia is a modular data availability blockchain. Connect to Celestia RPC, REST, and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Celestia is a modular data availability (DA) network that orders transactions and guarantees their data is published, while execution and settlement run on rollups built on top of it. It introduced data availability sampling so light nodes can verify availability without downloading full blocks. SwiftNodes provides Celestia RPC across load-balanced nodes.

chains.name: dYdX
chains.description: dYdX is a decentralized derivatives exchange built on Cosmos. Access dYdX RPC and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: dYdX Chain (dYdX v4) is a Cosmos SDK application-specific blockchain purpose-built for a decentralized perpetual-futures exchange with an off-chain orderbook and on-chain settlement. Validators run the matching engine and reach consensus with CometBFT. SwiftNodes provides dYdX Chain RPC across load-balanced nodes.

chains.name: Aptos
chains.description: Aptos is a Layer 1 blockchain using the Move language. Access Aptos REST API endpoints through SwiftNodes.
chains.overview: Aptos is a high-throughput Layer 1 built by former Meta (Diem) engineers, using the Move language and a parallel execution engine (Block-STM). It targets low, predictable latency with sub-second finality and is designed to scale transaction processing across many cores.

chains.name: Avail
chains.category: Modular data availability layer (Substrate / Polkadot NPoS)
chains.description: Avail is a modular data availability layer. Connect to Avail RPC and WebSocket endpoints.
chains.overview: Avail DA is a modular data availability layer built on Polkadot's Substrate framework, providing ordering and verifiable data publishing for rollups and other chains. It uses data availability sampling and validity proofs so light clients can confirm data was published without downloading full blocks. SwiftNodes provides Avail RPC across load-balanced nodes.

chains.name: Neutron
chains.description: Neutron is a Cosmos-based smart contract platform secured by Cosmos Hub. Access Neutron RPC and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Neutron is a Cosmos SDK smart-contract platform using the CosmWasm execution environment, designed for cross-chain DeFi applications connected over IBC. It launched as a Cosmos Hub Interchain Security consumer chain and later transitioned to its own validator set. SwiftNodes provides Neutron RPC across load-balanced nodes.

chains.name: Akash
chains.description: Akash is a decentralized cloud computing marketplace. Connect to Akash RPC, REST, and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Akash Network is a Cosmos SDK decentralized cloud compute marketplace where providers lease unused CPU and GPU capacity to tenants through a reverse-auction bidding system. Deployments are settled on-chain while workloads run in provider-operated Kubernetes clusters. SwiftNodes provides Akash RPC across load-balanced nodes.

chains.name: Axelar
chains.description: Axelar provides cross-chain communication for Web3. Access Axelar RPC, REST, and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Axelar is a Cosmos SDK proof-of-stake network for cross-chain interoperability, providing token bridging and General Message Passing (GMP) between connected blockchains. Validators run light clients and threshold cryptography to attest to events across chains. SwiftNodes provides Axelar RPC across load-balanced nodes.

chains.name: Babylon
chains.description: Babylon brings Bitcoin security to Cosmos chains via staking. Connect to Babylon RPC and gRPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Babylon Genesis is a Cosmos SDK chain that coordinates Bitcoin staking, letting BTC holders stake natively to provide security to proof-of-stake networks without bridging or wrapping. It uses Bitcoin timestamping and slashable self-custodial staking scripts. SwiftNodes provides Babylon RPC across load-balanced nodes.

chains.name: Polkadot Assethub
chains.category: Polkadot system parachain for native assets (Substrate)
chains.description: Polkadot Asset Hub is the native asset management parachain. Access Polkadot Assethub RPC endpoints.
chains.overview: Polkadot Asset Hub is a Substrate-based system parachain on Polkadot that specializes in issuing and managing fungible and non-fungible assets. It uses the relay chain's DOT as its native token and is secured by Polkadot's shared validator set. SwiftNodes provides Polkadot Asset Hub RPC across load-balanced nodes.
